app.name: ClientFlow
app.tagline: Client and order accounting for small businesses

common.serverDownText: ClientFlow could not reach its server. Try again in a minute.

register.title: Create an account
register.subtitle: A personal workspace is created for you automatically

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.description: We sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. Open it to activate your account.
checkEmail.spamHint: Can't find the email? Check the spam folder or send it again.
checkEmail.resent: If the account needs confirmation, a new link has been sent.

notVerified.message: Your email is not confirmed yet. Open the link from our email or request a new one.

verify.successDescription: Your account is active. You can sign in now.

forgot.title: Reset password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we will send you a reset link

reset.title: New password
reset.subtitle: Choose a new password for your account
reset.successDescription: You have been signed out on all devices. Sign in with your new password.
reset.missingToken: The reset link is incomplete. Request a new one.

auth.sceneCaption: Clients, orders and payments flow through one place.

validation.passwordMin: The password must be at least 8 characters long.
validation.passwordMax: The password must be at most 128 characters long.
validation.amount: Enter an amount greater than 0 with at most 2 decimal places.
